questions.q: How many Azure Data Factory accounts can you connect to a single Purview account at a time, per the lesson?
options: Up to 10 (more can be added in batches)
Unlimited
Exactly 1
Up to 3
questions.explain: Purview's management center allows connecting up to 10 Azure Data Factory accounts at a time; more can be added in additional batches.

questions.q: What role does an ADF or Synapse account's managed identity need, and where, to authenticate lineage pushes to Purview?
options: Global Administrator, in Microsoft Entra ID
Data Curator, on Purview's root collection
Owner, on the Azure subscription
No role is required for managed identities
questions.explain: The connecting account's managed identity must be granted the Data Curator role on Purview's root collection to authenticate lineage push operations.

questions.q: Which of the three lineage-reporting activity types does Azure Synapse NOT support, unlike Azure Data Factory?
options: Copy Data
Data Flow
Execute SSIS Package
Synapse supports all three identically
questions.explain: Synapse reports lineage from Copy Data and Data Flow activities, but not Execute SSIS Package, since Synapse pipelines don't run SSIS packages.

questions.q: What happens, per the lesson, if a Copy or Data Flow activity's source or sink uses a data system Purview doesn't support for lineage?
options: Purview throws a visible error and halts the pipeline
Purview automatically substitutes a generic placeholder asset
The entire Data Factory connection is disconnected
Purview drops the lineage silently, with no error anywhere
questions.explain: Purview silently drops lineage for unsupported sources or sinks — there's no error, which is exactly why confirming lineage status per run matters.

questions.q: In the n:1 Data Flow lineage pattern described in the lesson, what does Purview actually show?
options: The complete step-by-step join/merge transformation logic inside the data flow
Only the final output table, with no sources shown at all
Which sources and sink were involved, but not the detailed transformation logic inside the data flow
A separate lineage graph for each row of data processed
questions.explain: For Data Flow activities, Purview's lineage shows the source and sink involved but doesn't capture the detailed transformation steps (joins, merges) inside the data flow itself.
